payload.name: evidence_source_admission_stage1

criteria.primary_hypothesis: H1: dU(S4-S1) > 0 (paired bootstrap 95%CI lower bound > 0) on >= 2 of 3 endpoints
criteria.null_hypothesis: H0: dU <= 0 or CI crosses 0 on >= 2 endpoints
secondary: H2: cost-grid scan c_abstain in {0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1.0} x c_false_PASS in {2,5,10}; report all points
H3: dU(S4-S3) not positive at c_ref

sample.stopping: fixed n, single unblinding, no post-hoc top-up

criteria.failure_rule: if >=2/3 endpoints have CI lower bound <= 0 -> H1 not supported; publish negative result
criteria.estimand_rule: if any endpoint estimand NOT_BOUND -> withdraw inferential claim for that endpoint
criteria.forbidden: compare AUC (ranking, chance 0.5) with always-positive accuracy (prevalence) in the same sentence

prospective_data_window.on_violation: 违规记录不得进入主分析集（exit 4）
